configurations.name: cs-brief-ui-sandbox
runtimeArgs: $d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cs-brief-sandbox'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; Copy-Item config\scoring.yaml $d -Force; Remove-Item (Join-Path $d 'settings.yaml') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item (Join-Path $d 'secrets'), (Join-Path $d 'data') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $env:CS_BRIEF_CONFIG_DIR = $d; $env:CS_BRIEF_SECRETS_DIR = Join-Path $d 'secrets'; $env:CS_BRIEF_DATA_DIR = Join-Path $d 'data'; Remove-Item Env:CS_BRIEF_HUBSPOT_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:CS_BRIEF_OPENROUTER_KEY, Env:CS_BRIEF_OPENROUTER_API_BASE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'cs-brief\venv'; uv run cs-brief ui --no-browser --port 8001

configurations.name: cs-brief-ui-sandbox-keep
runtimeArgs: $d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cs-brief-sandbox'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; $env:CS_BRIEF_CONFIG_DIR = $d; $env:CS_BRIEF_SECRETS_DIR = Join-Path $d 'secrets'; $env:CS_BRIEF_DATA_DIR = Join-Path $d 'data'; Remove-Item Env:CS_BRIEF_HUBSPOT_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:CS_BRIEF_OPENROUTER_KEY, Env:CS_BRIEF_OPENROUTER_API_BASE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'cs-brief\venv'; uv run cs-brief ui --no-browser --port 8001

configurations.name: cs-brief-ui-fake-hubspot
runtimeArgs: $d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cs-brief-fake-hubspot'; Remove-Item $d -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'config'), (Join-Path $d 'secrets'), (Join-Path $d 'data') | Out-Null; Copy-Item config\scoring.yaml (Join-Path $d 'config') -Force; $env:CS_BRIEF_CONFIG_DIR = Join-Path $d 'config'; $env:CS_BRIEF_SECRETS_DIR = Join-Path $d 'secrets'; $env:CS_BRIEF_DATA_DIR = Join-Path $d 'data'; Remove-Item Env:CS_BRIEF_HUBSPOT_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $env:CS_BRIEF_HUBSPOT_API_BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8799'; $env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'cs-brief\venv'; uv run cs-brief ui --no-browser --port 8002

configurations.name: cs-brief-ui-fake-ai
runtimeArgs: $d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cs-brief-fake-ai'; Remove-Item $d -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'config'), (Join-Path $d 'secrets'), (Join-Path $d 'data') | Out-Null; Copy-Item config\scoring.yaml (Join-Path $d 'config') -Force; $env:CS_BRIEF_CONFIG_DIR = Join-Path $d 'config'; $env:CS_BRIEF_SECRETS_DIR = Join-Path $d 'secrets'; $env:CS_BRIEF_DATA_DIR = Join-Path $d 'data'; Remove-Item Env:CS_BRIEF_HUBSPOT_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:CS_BRIEF_OPENROUTER_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $env:CS_BRIEF_OPENROUTER_API_BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8798/api/v1'; $env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'cs-brief\venv'; uv run cs-brief ui --no-browser --port 8003
